## 02 / Learn by building

First-year B.Tech Computer Science student at NCERC Pambady, Kerala. Got into
coding at 12 and never stopped — IoT, web, and backend, mostly figured out as I
go.

Most of my projects started because I wanted to understand how something works.
I use AI tools to move faster, and I make sure I can explain every line I ship —
how the data flows, where it can break, and why it's built that way. Some
projects are finished, some are still being figured out.

Right now I'm looking for an internship where I can actually contribute and learn
from people who've been doing this longer than me.

Numbers: started coding at 12 · 4 projects shipped · curiosity, unbounded.

## 03 / Selected work

### ExamForge — full-stack · AI
Mock-exam platform for JEE and VIT. A full-screen timed test engine with a
question palette, flagging, per-question timing and auto-submit; AI post-exam
analysis and explanations through the Groq API; and an admin panel for the
question bank.
Stack: Next.js 14 · TypeScript · Supabase (Postgres, RLS) · Groq
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/ExamForge

### Gas Guard — IoT · embedded
Calibrates an MQ2 gas sensor at boot, then on a leak sounds a buzzer, opens a
servo-driven vent and pushes a Blynk alert. Serves its own web dashboard, falls
back to an access point when Wi-Fi is down, and updates over the air.
Stack: C++ · ESP8266 (NodeMCU) · MQ2 · Blynk
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/GAS-GUARD

### NMHSS Thirunavaya — live in production · team of 2
The official website for my school, live and in daily use. I built the frontend
— the public pages and the admin screens staff use to publish news, events and
gallery media — working with a backend developer on the Express API.
Stack: React · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Vite
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/nmhss-project

### Orvaya — client work
Website built for a real business. Professional look, works properly on every
screen size.
Repository: https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/Orvaya
